title: Live matrix
scope: e2e/live-matrix.mjs calls the live DFX sandbox or production API and sends no on-chain transaction. The only stand-in found in the script is the bundler URL on the two ERC-4337 cases.

entries.component: ERC-4337 bundler for polygon-4337 and base-4337
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] sets polygon-4337 bundlerUrl to https://bundler.invalid. [ref 1] sets the same URL for base-4337. Neither object sets a paymaster URL.
entries.insteadOf: a bundler that can submit a user operation on that chain
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that an ERC-4337 account can submit a user operation.
